name: Ob Nixilis's cavern
description: A cavern between two peaks ringed by inward-pointing hedrons and blocked with an iridescent crust, where the demon holds his captives.

timeline.summary: Chandra reaches the cavern, sees visions of her parents in the crust, and smashes the barrier.
